*Effective date: October 10, 2026*

[social-publisher](social-publisher.qmd) is a personal tool by Ziyue Li. It runs only on my own Mac and is used only with my own accounts. This policy explains what data the tool uses.

## Google and YouTube data

When I sign in with Google, the tool asks for permission to:

- upload videos to my YouTube channel (`youtube.upload`), and
- read my channel's basic details, such as its name (`youtube.readonly`).

The tool uses this access only to upload videos that I choose and approve, and to show which channel I am signed in to. It does not read, collect or store any other Google or YouTube data.

## Where data is stored

The sign-in tokens from Google are stored only on my Mac, in the macOS Keychain. Upload records (file name, platform, status and the link to the published video) are stored only on my Mac. The tool has no server, and no data is sent to the developer or to anyone else, except the video and its details, which are sent to YouTube when I publish.

## Sharing, advertising and analytics

The tool does not share, sell or transfer any data. It has no advertising and no analytics.

## Limited Use

social-publisher's use and transfer of information received from Google APIs adheres to the [Google API Services User Data Policy](https://developers.google.com/terms/api-services-user-data-policy), including the Limited Use requirements.

## Revoking access

I can remove the tool's access at any time at [myaccount.google.com/permissions](https://myaccount.google.com/permissions). Deleting the tool's Keychain entries removes the stored tokens from the Mac.

## Changes and contact

This policy may be updated when the tool changes. Questions: [liziyue241@gmail.com](mailto:liziyue241@gmail.com).
